183965: Fern is the young mage apprentice of Frieren and accompanies her as a member of her party. She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by Heiter and placed under Frieren's care.
184310: A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of Fern until Frieren arrived.
184311: Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on Frieren, with whom he had adventures for 10 years.
184312: Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to Stark.

219110: Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King.

219733: She lived a millennium before the story and was Frieren's teacher.
